basics.name: Danilo Díaz Tarascó
basics.label: CTO | IoT & Embedded Systems | Cloud | IIoT | Hardware + Software
basics.summary: Hands-on CTO and electronics engineer with 10+ years delivering IIoT products across embedded systems, connected hardware, and AWS-backed platforms. Leads a 12-engineer team inside a 30-person company and helped drive the business from negative to positive EBITDA while supporting ~60% revenue growth over three years. Builds across the stack, from MCU firmware, PCB design, and FCC certification to serverless infrastructure and production rollouts in LATAM, the Caribbean, and the US.

work.name: Sento IoT+Electronics Hub
highlights: Leads a 12-engineer team setting technical vision and product roadmap for the IIoT portfolio while sustaining 99.9% uptime across deployed IoT infrastructure.
Helped move the business from negative to positive EBITDA and supported ~60% revenue growth over three years by prioritizing high-value verticals from field demand.
Expanded the portfolio into maritime cargo tracking, chemical dosing and control for food processing, and precision agriculture monitoring.
Integrates AI tooling and automation into engineering workflows; owns architecture across embedded firmware, edge systems, and AWS backends.

work.name: Sento IoT+Electronics Hub
highlights: Led a multidisciplinary team delivering IIoT systems for poultry and swine production in harsh industrial environments.
Designed and validated IPC-compliant PCBs, mechanical enclosures, solar telemetry, and chemical dosing control cabinets.
Managed export compliance and scaled prototypes from 3D printing to injection molding for LATAM, Caribbean, and US rollout.
Applied a hardware-adapted Scrum cadence to align firmware, hardware, and cloud deliverables.

work.name: PowDevs (client: Blackline Safety)
highlights: Built fully serverless REST API infrastructure on AWS for a connected safety-device platform.
Delivered infrastructure as code with CloudFormation and SAM across API Gateway, Cognito, Lambda, and OpenAPI specs.
Authored Python Lambda services for data pipelines and maintained CI/CD through CodePipeline.

work.name: Vantu S.A.S (now Sento IoT+Electronics Hub)
highlights: Designed scalable IPC-compliant PCBs for self-service IoT devices deployed in harsh agricultural environments.
Achieved FCC certification and built MicroPython firmware with supervisor mechanisms for availability and energy efficiency.
Built AWS infrastructure for FOTA at scale and supported expansion into the US, Central America, and the Caribbean.

work.name: Innavitas SAPI - Wiot
highlights: Developed embedded IoT systems for industrial and automotive hydrogen-generation control.
Programmed MCUs in C/C++ and Arduino and designed production PCBs in Altium Designer.
Built Linux-based embedded platforms, web interfaces, and computer-vision pipelines with OpenCV and Python.
